semantic_insights: The record explicitly distinguishes the project/latest-version DOI from the release DOI, avoiding an apparent identifier conflict.
The participant history is arithmetically coherent: 306 plus 136 plus 391 equals 833, and version 3.1.0 adds no new participants.
Registered derived features and controlled raw audio are consistently distinguished in privacy, access and agreement descriptions.
Named processing software is tied to transformations of distributed data, satisfying the software criterion independently of capture and hosting applications.
Source caveats distinguish historical documentation, planned enrollment, separate pediatric data and current-release facts.
Actionable access instructions, changelog descriptions, raw-source provenance and named hosting are credited at their actual root locations without inventing missing fields.
All 50 items remain in the denominator because no applicability predicates were independently declared.
